HAL.configure_0x2db0: Rejects null at 0x2de4 with 3 and non-AArch64 VMSA at 0x2e84 with 21. Copies fields at 0x2e10–0x2e7c. Does not validate TCR/table geometry. Attach 0x1e54–0x1ee4 programs the copied config for the newly allocated bank.
HAL.aspace_0x4840: Validates nonzero size and 4 KiB-aligned base and size. Root allocation 0x4918 calls 0x1730 then 0x8a5c, which sets w0=4 (EfiBootServicesData). AllocatePages call is reached at 0x88c8 or 0x88e8.
HAL.layout: HAL AArch64 defaults at 0x2cd0: TCR 0x00802010, 48-bit input, 4KiB L0 walk, TTBR1 disabled. TCR2 0x0003c071, 36-bit output. MAIR0 0x00ff0400, AttrIndx 2 is 0xff. SCTLR 0x00c000e7. Stage 1 leaves use AF, inner shareable, RW and XN.
HAL.handoff: B5qHandoffDxe configures USB0 ARID 0x03000000 only with HAL. Reserved table pool, cache clean and dsb sy. Largest aligned 1 GiB blocks, 2 MiB and 4 KiB for descriptor edges. Only conventional RAM and the allocated XNU window head between 2 GiB and 64 GiB, excluding reserved holes and the table pool. DarwinBoot verifies retention against the map accepted by ExitBootServices.
HAL.status: v27 XNU reads the unchanged 48-byte status ABI and gates host/device/VBUS. Firmware publishes per-step codes and a separate table diagnostics property. Runtime validation pending.
